summary: Creates and configures a Direct3D-style rendering device for the input/HW module. Seeds two constant arrays with an 8-iteration loop, optionally re-enumerates the device through the ppvOut interface when the capability/version field at offset 0x2F4 differs from 20, creates the device (pointer stored at offset 0x80), releases a temporary interface handle, configures the device through vtable slots (offset 0xC parameter block, 0x18/0x1C/0x20/0x2C/0x34 methods), and finishes by calling D3DTextureStage. Called from HWInput_Setup (0x00455C60).

local_names.a2: second argument forwarded to the device method at vtable offset 52
local_names.a3: third argument, unused in the body
local_names.v4: loop iterator destination pointer into this
local_names.v6: copy of the interface handle obtained from ppvOut
local_names.v7: address of the device pointer field (this + 32 dwords, offset 0x80)
local_names.v8: device pointer for the offset 12 device method call
local_names.v9: device pointer for the offset 24 device method call
local_names.v11: temporary interface handle returned by the ppvOut method at offset 12
local_names.v12: parameter block for the offset 24 device method call (v12[0]=20, v12[1]=16, rest zeroed)

operations.description: Repeat 8 times: write 1028443341 into this[8+i] and 1065353216 into this[190+i], advancing the destination pointer each iteration.
Set dword_7CB310 to 0 inside the capability-version guard body.

If this[189] (field offset 0x2F4) != 20, call the ppvOut interface method at vtable offset 16 with (ppvOut, 4, sub_44ED10, 20, 1); return -1 if that call succeeds with a failure result or if the field still differs from 20.
Call the ppvOut interface method at vtable offset 12 with (ppvOut, this + 34 dwords, &v11, 0); return -1 if it fails.
Clear the device pointer field this[32] (offset 0x80) to 0 before creating the device.
Call the interface obtained from v11 (its vtable slot 0) with (&unk_5AD490, this + 32); return -1 if it fails. On success the device pointer is stored into this[32] (offset 0x80).
If this[32] (device pointer at offset 0x80) is still zero after the create call, return -1.
Release the temporary v11 interface through its vtable method at offset 8.
Call the new device's vtable method at offset 32 (field 0x20 of *(*(this+0x80)+0x0)) with the device pointer.
Call the device vtable method at offset 44 (field 0x2C of *(*(this+0x80)+0x0)) with (&unk_5B108C); return -1 on failure.
Call the device vtable method at offset 52 (field 0x34 of *(*(this+0x80)+0x0)) with (a2, 9); return -1 on failure.
Set this[178] (offset 0x2C8) to 44 before the offset 12 device method call.
Call the device vtable method at offset 12 (field 0xC of *(*(this+0x80)+0x0)) with (device, this + 178 / offset 0x2C8); return -1 on failure.
Fill the v12 parameter block: v12[0]=20, v12[1]=16, and zero the remaining 12 bytes.
Call the device vtable method at offset 24 (field 0x18 of *(*(this+0x80)+0x0)) with (device, 5, v12).
Call the device vtable method at offset 28 (field 0x1C of *(*(this+0x80)+0x0)) with the device pointer.
Return the result of D3DTextureStage((int)this); every earlier failure path returns -1.

unresolved: The interface obtained from ppvOut (global 0x007CA590) and the device stored at this+0x80 are only exercised through vtable slots; the exact Direct3D/DirectDraw interface identities are not established by the packet.
The 8-iteration loop writes this[8..15] and this[190..197], offsets absent from the packet field table; the literal constants 1028443341 and 1065353216 are kept in packet spelling.
The vtable slots invoked through ppvOut and v11 (offsets 0, 8, 12, 16) have no packet field evidence refs and are described only from source:raw.
